description: Shared Renovate preset for all jdwlabs repositories — consumed as github>jdwlabs/.github.
Renovate is the single owner of dependency automation in this org; repository-level (UI) Dependabot should remain disabled so updates arrive through one reviewable pipeline.
Regular updates are batched weekly (non-major updates grouped into one PR per repo) to keep review load low; security/vulnerability fixes bypass the schedule and open immediately.
Branches are kept rebased on the base branch so PRs stay fast-forward-clean for rebase-only merging.

packageRules.description: Batch all non-major updates into a single weekly PR per repo to keep noise reviewable

GitHub Actions updates are committed as ci(deps), not chore(deps). The release tooling on these repositories cuts a patch for chore(deps) so dependency fixes reach production, but an Action bump changes only CI: as chore(deps) it would publish an image, recreate a pod or redeploy a site with nothing in it that changed.
Non-major Action updates get a weekly group of their own. A group produces one commit, so mixing them with application dependencies would force a single commit type on both.

customManagers.description: Release tooling run as `npx -p <package>@<version>` inside workflows, which no built-in manager reads. Without this the pins would never move.
